svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cup 72 dia x 80 tall. Socket at the bottom 43 dia x 26 deep for the tube;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 mm floor with a 28 mm hole; cavity 62 dia above it, 5 mm wall.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two board guides on the side walls, slot 1.8 wide, 3 deep, 44 tall,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: starting 36 above the bottom: the board stands on the slot ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two bosses 8 dia, 29.5 each side of centre (at right angles to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: guides), with 4.6 mm holes 6 deep for M3 heat-set inserts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Gland boss 14 dia with an 8.2 mm hole, 60 up, toward the marker rod

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 30 degrees round toward the front (away from the board).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Vent boss 12 dia with a 4 mm hole, 42 up, at the back right.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: LED lens hole 5.2 dia through the wall, 60 up, front right, at least

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 45 degrees round from the gland and the vent.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Press the inserts in with a soldering iron at about 220 C, flush.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the rim is flat (no gap under a straightedge) for the O-ring;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the board slides down both guides without force; the LED's 5.8 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flange sits against the inside wall and cannot pass the hole.
